lane: نَيْرَبٌ (S, K) and ↓نَيْرَبَةٌ (as in several copies of the K, [and I am inclined to think that this is the correct reading, as it may certainly be correctly used in the sense here given, being properly an inf. n., agreeably with analogy,] or ↓مَنْرَبَةٌ (as in others, which is said in the TA to be the correct word, and to be given on the authority of AA, [but it exhibits an incongruity of letters: see 1:]) Mischief; malicious and mischievous misrepresentation, calumny, or slander. (S, K.) === نَيْرَبٌ, fem. with ة; and ذُو نَيْرَبٍ; A mischievous man; (K;) one who utters malicious and mischievous misrepresentations, calumnies, or slanders. (TA.) === نَيْرَبٌ A strong man. (K.)

entries.text: نيرب: سعى، ونم، وخلط الكلام، ونسج. والنيرب: الشر، والنميمة، كالنيربة، والرجل الجليد، وة بدمشق وبحلب، وع. والنيربى: الداهية. ورجل نيرب، وذو نيرب: شرير، وهي نيربة. والريح تنيرب التراب فوقه: تنسجه.
